virāga + una

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ, āvuso, abalaṃ virāgunaṃ anassāsikan'ti viditvā ye viññāṇe upāy'ūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittan'ti pajānāmi.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

68892.meaning1: fading of desire and calming; dispassion and tranquility; detachment and peace
68892.commentary: (ITIa) virāg'ūpasame'ti virāge upasame ca, sabbassa rāgassa sabbesaṃ kilesānaṃ accantavirāga-hetubhūte accanta-upasama-hetubhūte cā'ti attho.

examples.text: agge dhamme pasannānaṃ, virāg'ūpasame sukhe, agge saṅghe pasannānaṃ, puññakkhette anuttare.

68895.commentary: (ANa) virājayan'ti virājento, virājetvā vā. virājento'ti hi vutte maggo kathito hoti, virājetvā'ti vutte phalaṃ.

examples.text: diṭṭhiyogaṃ samūhacca, avijjañ'ca virājayaṃ, sabbayogavisaṃyuttā, te ve yog'ātigā munī'ti.

68896.meaning1: having detached (from); having lost interest (in); having lost desire (for); having become indifferent (to); having become dispassionate (towards)
68896.meaning2: having detached; having lost interest (in); having lost desire (for); having made indifferent (to)

examples.text: idh'eva cittāni virājayitvā, kāmesu ādīnavam'addasaṃsu, te kāmasaṃyojanabandhanāni, pāpimayogāni duraccayāni.

68898.synonym: niddhanta, ninnīta, nīhaṭa, parisuddha, visuddha, vīvadāta, vodāta

examples.text: yesaṃ rāgo ca doso ca, avijjā ca virājitā, khīṇ'āsavā arahanto, tesaṃ vijaṭitā jaṭā.
